questions.q: Which role does this lesson describe as the most common entry point into a Salesforce career and the foundation every other role sits on?
questions.explain: The lesson names Administrator as the most common entry point and the foundation the other four roles build on.

questions.q: According to the lesson, what does a Platform App Builder add on top of Administrator skills?
options: The ability to design and deploy full custom applications declaratively, without code
Designing org-wide architecture across multiple clouds
questions.explain: The lesson defines Platform App Builder as extending Administrator skills into full custom applications built declaratively, no code required.

questions.q: Which Salesforce ecosystem role does the lesson describe as designing how an entire org, or one architecture domain, holds together at scale?
questions.explain: The lesson identifies Architect as the role responsible for how an org (or a domain like data, sharing, or integration) holds together at scale.

questions.q: What capstone project does the lesson say this student has already built by reaching the end of the Salesforce Administrator path?
questions.explain: The lesson states the student has built the LTV Customer Management System capstone by the end of the Administrator path.

questions.q: What two destinations does the lesson say the Salesforce Administrator path branches into after this course?
options: Salesforce Data Analyst / CRM Analytics and Salesforce Technical Architect
Salesforce Consultant and Salesforce Sales Professional
Only Salesforce Technical Architect — there is no second destination
questions.explain: The lesson names Salesforce Data Analyst / CRM Analytics and Salesforce Technical Architect as the two destinations this path branches into.
